meta.title: PROCE55US — Prompt a processus. Watch it draw.
meta.description: PROCE55US is a creative-coding atelier: a notebook of steps where each cell pairs a natural-language prompt with the code an AI model generates, rendered live in a sandboxed preview.
hero.tagline: Prompt a PROCESSUS. Watch it draw.
hero.sub: A creative-coding atelier: a notebook of steps where each cell pairs a natural-language prompt with the code a model writes for it — rendered live in a sandboxed preview.
shot.alt: The PROCE55US app: prompts and code cells on the left, live preview on the right
features.title: Made for teaching creative coding.
features.lead: Students read a prompt, see the code it produces, tweak, regenerate — and watch the sketch evolve one step at a time.
f1.title: Prompt-driven steps
f1.text: Each cell is a written intention. The model generates the code; the preview runs it instantly. Edit the prompt, regenerate the code.
f2.title: Editable code
f2.text: The generated code isn't locked: students can read it, edit it directly in the cell, and rerun — or regenerate from the prompt.
f3.title: Live preview
f3.text: Cells replay in order inside a sandboxed page. No build step, no tooling — the result appears as soon as the code does.
f4.title: Local-first AI
f4.text: Works fully offline with LM Studio. Prefer the cloud? Switch to a free Google, Groq, Mistral or OpenRouter key in one click.
how.title: How it works.
s1.title: Write a prompt
s1.text: Describe what the code should do — “fill the canvas with animated particles” — in plain language.
s2.title: Generate
s2.text: The model writes runnable JavaScript, aware of the cells above and the functions already defined.
s3.title: Run & iterate
s3.text: Cells replay in order in a live canvas. Undo, restart, or export the result as a standalone HTML page.
dl.title: Download PROCE55US.
dl.meta: macOS 12 or later · Apple Silicon & Intel ·
dl.fine: First launch: macOS warns that the app « cannot be opened » — it isn't notarized with a paid Apple certificate. Click Done, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway and confirm. It opens normally from then on.
